## Objective

Investigate whether Flashalign pose plus bounded anatomical field improves the remaining HalfFlow problem. Provide a checked receiving seam only when its endpoint/midpoint model supports the transfer; compare against direct runs from the same affine.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 3.3, 13, FA-14B. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `C6 composition adapter experiment`
- `composed map/inverse tests`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Complete-original map versus residual map is explicit in types and records; T=R after A and reverse composition are independently tested.
2. Domains/inverse/topology are requalified after composition/regridding, and output samples the original image once.
3. Record complete extra-stage cost and positive/negative/incompatible result; the experiment can conclude no supported benefit without enabling a composition.

## Blocking prerequisites

- C05: FA-C05: Compare economical and richer nonlinear models from the same affine
- C04: FA-C04: Compare Flashalign initialization against the existing HalfFlow pipeline
- N13: FA-N13: Implement nonlinear records, inverse evidence and bounded output

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-C06: Evaluate constrained pre-refinement followed by HalfFlow residual fitting
